pattern: ^(:: )?\d+ packages? ha(s|ve) newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints\.$
reason: Summary line of pub get. Every held-back package is still gated on its own line below, so a new one fails the check. The snap build prefixes its part output with ':: '.

pattern: ^\s*(material_color_utilities|test_api) \S+ \(\S+ available\)$
reason: Pinned by the Flutter SDK (flutter / flutter_test). Resolves with the next Flutter SDK release.

pattern: ^\s*cross_file 0\.3\.\S+ \(0\.4\.\S+ available\)$
reason: Held by share_plus and file_selector (latest releases) which still require cross_file ^0.3.

pattern: ^\s*dbus 0\.7\.\S+ \(0\.8\.\S+ available\)$
reason: Held by audio_service_mpris (latest release) which still requires dbus ^0.7.

pattern: ^\s*equatable 2\.\S+ \(3\.\S+ available\)$
reason: Held by alarm (latest release) which still requires equatable ^2.

pattern: ^\s*cli_util 0\.4\.\S+ \(0\.6\.\S+ available\)$
reason: Dev tooling only: held by flutter_launcher_icons and msix (latest releases) which still require cli_util ^0.4.

pattern: ^! flutter_rust_bridge 2\.11\.1 \(overridden\) \(\S+ available\)$
reason: smtc_windows 1.1.0 (latest) ships bindings generated with flutter_rust_bridge 2.11.1; see the override reason in pubspec.yaml. Ends with a smtc_windows release on 2.13 or our own fork.

pattern: ^WARNING: Your app uses the following plugins that apply Kotlin Gradle Plugin \(KGP\): alarm, home_widget$
reason: alarm 5.15.0 and home_widget 0.10.0 (latest) still apply KGP in their own Gradle files. Upstream reports are drafted; the Flutter tool prints this before Gradle runs, so no app-side change removes it.

pattern: ^Warning: Building for device with codesigning disabled\. You will have to manually codesign before deploying to device\.$
reason: The iOS job is an unsigned compile check by design (no signing secrets outside releases); Flutter prints this notice for every --no-codesign build.

pattern: ^/.+/sentry_flutter-\d+\.\d+\.\d+/Sources/sentry_flutter_objc/include/SentryFlutterReplayScreenshotProvider\.h:\d+:\d+: warning: pointer is missing a nullability type specifier
reason: Header of sentry_flutter 10.7.0 (latest) compiled into the Runner for the widget snapshot test; the plugin's own Objective-C lacks a nullability annotation. A third-party source file, so no app-side change removes it.

pattern: ^1 warning generated\.$
reason: Summary line of the single sentry_flutter header warning allow-listed above; it disappears with it. sentry_flutter 10.7.0 is the latest release, a command-line OTHER_CFLAGS suppression does not reach the Swift package target.

pattern: ^Warning: Could not fetch system log stream: spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT$
reason: Printed by the Post step of step-security/harden-runner on the macOS runner when its system-log query times out after the simulator run (seen in 2 of 4 runs, the job itself is green). Only the hardening report is lost, no build or test result. No app-side change removes it; re-check with the next harden-runner release.

pattern: ^Warning: 'no file associated with this alert' is not a valid URI in 'instance\.runs\[\d+\]\.results\[\d+\]\.locations\[0\]\.physicalLocation\.artifactLocation\.uri'\.$
reason: ossf/scorecard writes this placeholder URI for repository-level findings and github/codeql-action warns while uploading the SARIF. Reported upstream in the ossf/scorecard tracker (bug titled 'URI "no file associated with this alert" in SARIF now invalid in github/codeql-action'), closed there but still emitted by scorecard-action 2.5.0. The findings are uploaded; only the file location is dropped.

pattern: ^\(node:\d+\) \[DEP0005\] DeprecationWarning: Buffer\(\) is deprecated
reason: Printed by actions/download-artifact v8.0.2 (latest) on every download. Reported upstream in the actions/download-artifact tracker (open: 'v8 emits Node DEP0005 Buffer() deprecation warning on every download').

pattern: ^\(node:\d+\) \[DEP0040\] DeprecationWarning: The `punycode` module is deprecated
reason: Printed by actions/deploy-pages v5.0.1 (latest) through its bundled @actions/artifact. Reported upstream in the actions/deploy-pages tracker (open: 'v5 emits Node DEP0040 punycode deprecation warning on successful deployments').

pattern: ^WARNING: Java vector incubator module is not readable\.
reason: Lucene inside dependency-check prints this notice when the incubator vector module is off; enabling it makes the JVM print 'Using incubator modules' instead. Ends when dependency-check ships a Lucene/JDK combination without the incubator module.

pattern: ^\[WARN\] dependency skipped: node module @oxc-parser/binding-[a-z0-9-]+ seems optional and not installed$
reason: oxc-parser (dev tooling of tool/perf, pulled in by lighthouse through @sentry/node) ships one optional native binding per platform; npm installs only the linux-x64 one, even with --force. dependency-check 13.0.0 warns for every uninstalled optional package without a switch to turn it off (NodePackageAnalyzer.shouldSkipDependency). The bindings are builds of the same oxc-parser version, which is installed and analyzed, so no coverage is lost. An upstream request for a quieter log level is still to be filed.

pattern: ^(:: )?WARNING: Library target 'placebo' has 'name_prefix' set\.
reason: Meson notice from the libplacebo build files (upstream v7.387.0); built as a dependency of libmpv, nothing to change on our side.

pattern: apt/package\.py:\d+: Warning: W:Download is performed unsandboxed as root as file '/root/\.cache/snapcraft/download/\S+\.deb' couldn't be accessed by user '_apt'
reason: snapcraft downloads stage packages as root into its own cache; the apt sandbox user cannot read it. Comes from snapcraft, not from snapcraft.yaml.

pattern: Node\.js 20 is deprecated\. The following actions target Node\.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node\.js 24: snapcore/action-build@
reason: snapcore/action-build v1.3.0 is the latest release and still declares node20; it runs on Node.js 24 without problems.

pattern: ^\(node:\d+\) \[DEP0040\] DeprecationWarning: The `punycode` module is deprecated
reason: Printed by the Node runtime inside the flatpak-github-actions container (download-artifact and flatpak-builder actions); not our code.

pattern: ^(:: )?Warning: Non-SPDX licenses are deprecated\. Use SPDX license strings or 'proprietary' instead\.
reason: snapcraft warns about license: Proprietary but rejects the lowercase 'proprietary' it suggests when packing (unknown license). The app has no SPDX licence; Proprietary is the only value snapcraft accepts.

pattern: ^Warning: Could not fetch system log stream: spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT$
reason: Printed by the post step of step-security/harden-runner v2.23.0 on macOS runners (setup UI and Gatekeeper evidence jobs): after the job it dumps the agent's unified log via a spawnSync shell call with a fixed timeout, which can time out on a busy runner. Purely diagnostic output of a third-party action, not of the build; the action documents no input that turns it off.

pattern: \blevel=WARN msg="(pid reused|existing process not stopped, resetting it|Process event is older than \d+ seconds)
reason: The post step of step-security/harden-runner v2.23.0 dumps its Windows agent log into the job log; the agent warns each time Windows reuses a process id between its polls (1000+ lines per job, from build tools such as rustc, cmake and git). Process tracking of the third-party agent, not output of our build, and the action has no input to lower its log level. Re-check with the next harden-runner release.
